cells.gaps: No sector policy is in force: instruments.csv gives the National ICT Policy 2009 (reviewed 2017) as replaced in 2021 by the National Digital Development Policy, which is classed national, and no sector successor is on record as adopted or in preparation. SLE-016 gives to:2014, but that is the five-year implementation timeline and an implementation plan's period is not the policy's, so the period stays open. No reporting has been found. The governance facts (SLE-018 and SLE-019, 2009; SLE-006, 2022-12) fall outside the 36 months, and nothing is dated inside the last twelve months. SLE-005 (2022-12) states the absence of a national ICT strategy, but stage 1 is closed because a national digital strategy is held.
cells.note: National ICT Policy 2009 (reviewed 2017): approved on 28 October 2009 with its text public, an open sector policy that a national digital strategy replaced in 2021, so it is lapsed and the cell is unplaced under the national strategy. Stage 2 or 3 would need a sector policy in force or a sector successor in preparation, and none is held.
